k:会.mnemonic: A hat (𠆢) over a cocoon (厶). Everyone hides in their own cocoon until they put on their hat and go out to meet. Meet (and meeting).

k:学.mnemonic: Sparkles (⺌) above a forehead (冖), and a child (子) underneath. When a child studies hard the ideas sparkle above their forehead. Study.

k:見.mnemonic: A big eye (目) on top of a pair of legs (儿). It is an eye that walks around looking at things. See.

k:立.mnemonic: A person standing on the ground line with feet apart and arms out for balance. Stand.
k:立.hint: A figure standing on the ground.

k:女.mnemonic: A figure kneeling with arms crossed in the classic pose of old paintings of women. Woman.
k:女.hint: A kneeling figure with crossed arms.

k:小.mnemonic: One hook with a drop on either side, like something tiny being split even smaller. Small.
k:小.hint: A hook with two little drops.

k:目.mnemonic: An eye turned on its side: the outline, the iris, the pupil. Eye.

k:王.mnemonic: Three horizontal lines (heaven, humans, earth) joined by one vertical line: the one who connects them all is the king.
k:王.hint: Three levels joined by one line.

k:玉.mnemonic: A king (王) with a drop (丶) on his robe. That drop is his jewel. Jewel (and ball, since old jewels were round).

k:国.mnemonic: A fence (囗) built all the way around the jewel (玉). Build a fence around your king's jewel and you have a country.

k:田.mnemonic: A field seen from above, divided into four paddies by irrigation ditches. Rice field.

k:土.mnemonic: A sprout (the cross) standing in a line of ground. Plain, simple soil.

k:夕.mnemonic: A crescent moon (月) with the middle stroke missing, because in the early evening the moon is still faint. Evening.

k:名.mnemonic: A mouth (口) speaking in the evening (夕). When it is dark you cannot see who is coming, so you call out your name.

k:社.mnemonic: An altar (礻) built on soil (土). The people who gather round it are a society, and the group that works together is a company.

k:三.mnemonic: One (一) more line on top of two (二). Three.

k:地.mnemonic: Soil (土) with a scorpion (也) living in it. Where scorpions live in the soil, that is the earth, the ground. Earth.

k:向.mnemonic: A hood (冂) with a mouth (口) under it and a little stroke on top. It is a face inside a hood, turned towards you: facing.

k:同.mnemonic: One (一) line inside facing (向). Two people facing each other with one line between them are on the same page. Same.

k:川.mnemonic: Three streams of water flowing down side by side. River.

k:寸.mnemonic: A hand with a small mark at the wrist, where the pulse is. That is one thumb-width, an old unit of measurement.
k:寸.hint: A hand marked at the pulse.

k:寺.mnemonic: Soil (土) with a measurement (寸) under it. Monks measured out the soil very carefully before building their temple.

k:方.mnemonic: A signpost with an arm sticking out, pointing the way. Direction.
